text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 29, 2025) for 50 Lawton Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 29, 2025) for 50 Lawton Boulevard, Folder Number: 25 232459 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to February 28, 2027.
